turns.text: Would you like to keep a daily mood log?
Yes, I will track my mood every evening, for the day overall.
I will record my mood each night. I can add an energy rating too.
Will you repeat the breathing exercise we learned for three minutes after lunch?
Yes, I will repeat that exercise after lunch.
I tried breathing exercises last year. I do not want to repeat them now.
I will write down my mood each evening instead.
Could you make time for something enjoyable this week?
Yes, I will choose something enjoyable this week. Gardening feels relaxing, so that is one idea.
I will record my mood each evening and repeat the muscle relaxation exercise we learned.
I will record my mood each night.
Would you also make time for something enjoyable?
Yes, I will choose an enjoyable activity this week.
And will you repeat the breathing practice we did today?
Yes, I will repeat that breathing practice.
Would you practise the breathing exercise at home?
No, I do not want to practise that at home.
We practised breathing in today's session. How was it?
It was fine. I have not decided on anything to practise at home.
Will you repeat the muscle relaxation practice?
Yes, I will repeat that practice.
So we agreed on that same muscle relaxation practice.
Yes, that is the same plan.
